retained_frozen_benchmark_state.note: Single-scene sentinels do not replace a full benchmark macro until their complete frozen cohort is evaluated.

lerf3d.decision: Do not build a K=2 field or distributional head. The primary available gain is single-center alignment and query ranking; use the source-global generic-query response/listwise V2 objective.
lerf3d.implementation_status: V2 objective, scene-global hard-negative miner, trainer, tests, and one-scene dry loss are complete; full 24+8 training is not authorized because 31 of 32 SHA-bound scene authorities are absent.

nvos_horns_left.reason: The strict factorized-v2 field/raw-state pair is absent. Honest production requires a fresh 61-view source extraction and factorized field training; legacy normalized raw_radio lacks the required amplitude, dispersion, and evidence scalars.

confirmed: A globally trained registered-evidence head can convert sparse signed scribble evidence into a stronger graph-free NVOS unary.
The gain on fern exceeds both the retained hierarchical graph-off baseline and stronger canonical compact/factorized controls.
The same V1-to-V2 readout is not a universal full-mask cross-view completion head: it regresses the strong exact-adjoint Room comparator.

A shared canonical field remains reasonable, but the final query head must preserve strong registered analytic unaries: the current V1 flips 2047 fully observed Room primitives from analytic background to foreground and 2808 unobserved primitives in the opposite direction.
rejected: Unconditional graph completion and connected selection.
A K=2 LERF field as the next primary intervention.
Unconditional reuse of the sparse-prompt V1-to-V2 head for SPIn full-mask queries.
Post-hoc Room rescoring, threshold changes, per-scene fitting, or fallback selection after observing its metric.

implementation_corrections.execution_authority: Schema v2 now semantically binds both the clean source gate and independent cross-scene confirmation instead of trusting self-reported booleans.
implementation_corrections.materializer: The SupportedCalibration field mismatch was fixed and directly tested.
implementation_corrections.numeric_contract: Rendered probabilities must be finite, preserve unsupported exact zero, and remain within 1e-5 of [0,1] before a uniform clamp; larger violations fail closed.
implementation_corrections.room_numeric_observation: Across 40 frames only two values were clamped, with maximum correction 2.384185791015625e-7, so numeric sanitation cannot explain the 0.05759 IoU regression.

next_method_gate.lerf3d: Do not score another LERF benchmark candidate until the missing source-only response/listwise authorities exist and a multi-scene validation checkpoint passes query-ranking gates.
next_method_gate.nvos: Retain fern V2; do not claim a new NVOS macro until the remaining strict cohort has factorized-v2 assets and is evaluated once.
next_method_gate.spin9: Replace unconditional V1 updates with a globally coverage-gated observation-clamped residual: fully observed rows must remain the exact registered analytic unary and residual capacity is reserved for unobserved/partial rows. Train and validate this invariant on nonbenchmark held-out source-to-target scenes for both full-mask and scribble prompts, then use a different untouched SPIn scene for a one-shot sentinel.
